cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "That's the order filled and I'm still doing three days on the phone every fortnight. That's not a solution, that's you being nice."

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "So. Different idea. You seed me a time vein and I buy it off you. Then it's mine, it produces, and the standing order fills itself."

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "You take the risk — the forty units, the seeding, whether it takes. I take a working vein and pay for it. That's not charity in either direction, that's just what things are worth."
It is the first time anyone in the Collective has proposed a transaction to you where both halves were named out loud, and it's oddly restful.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "Grow it a bit first if you've any sense. I'll pay what it's worth on the day, and a hole in the ground with forty units in it isn't worth much yet."
You now know that a vein is a thing that can be sold, which had genuinely not occurred to you.
